title: At 8, Vivienne Harr of California, opened a lemonade stand after seeing a photo of enslaved children
summary_full: Vivienne Harr, a remarkable eight-year-old from Fairfax, California, turned a childhood lemonade stand into a beacon of hope against child slavery. Inspired by a chilling image depicting the plight of enslaved children, she aimed to raise $100,000. Upon hitting her target, her dedication didn’t waver; she spent an entire year expanding her mission, creating organic bottled beverages that now support various charities.
